notes.title: Dungeon Exiles 1.0.5
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Gronkins here with patch 1.0.5 of Dungeon Exiles. So this is another smaller update, however, this may be one of the last for Dungeon Exiles (at least for now). Of course, if any major issues pop up, or if you have any questions I’ll still be around to help but I think it’s time I moved on from Dungeon Exiles

Dungeon Exiles has grown into something far bigger than I ever really expected. For context, Dungeon Exiles was my first game and I understand it's a bit rough around the edges, and there are still issues but for the most part, it was just a game I built to learn game development. The fact Dungeon Exiles found such an audience (or an audience at all!) is something I truly never expected, so for that, I do thank all of you!

I do apologise as (at least for the time being) I do not plan on supporting Dungeon Exiles with new content, classes, QoL updates, new game modes, or anything like that and I also apologise for not being able to fix all the current issues in the game but Dungeon Exiles just isn't something I enjoy working on any more

However, I just want to give one final thank you to all the patient and diligent players who helped me fix many of the issues and bugs with the game and provided me with so much feedback, and of course, thank you to everyone who gave my little indie game a try!

With all that said, here are the patch notes:

Balance Changes

Mage

Abilities

Brilliance (Base):
Mana Regenerated Per Second: 0.2 -> 0.4

Fireball, Frostbolt, Lightning Bolt:
Damage has been increased by roughly 5% at all levels

Time Warp of the Paradox:
Duration (Seconds): 12 -> 6
Maximum Cooldown Recovery Rate: 0% -> 3%

Passive Skills

Arcane Warrior:
Increased Attack Damage: 14% -> 16%
Battlemage:
Increased Attack Damage: 12% -> 14%
Elemental Strikes:
Percentage of Physical Damage as Extra Lightning Damage: 30% -> 35%
Rising Tempest:
Increased Attack Damage per Stack: 2.5% -> 2.8%

Items

New Treasure Item:
Temporal Hourglass
Quality: Legendary

+5% to Maximum Cooldown Recovery Rate
10% increased Cooldown Recovery Rate
Gain 1% increased Attack Speed per 3% Cooldown Recovery Rate

Cloak of Endless Night:
Required Evasion for 1 Energy Shield:
4 -> 2

Achievements

Outskilled:
Now only requires 30 attacks to be parried to unlock (Down from 40)

Bug Fixes

Fixed some tooltip issues where Damage over Time effects weren’t displaying their effects properly
Fixed an issue where the Shadow Dancer’s Boots weren’t unlocking correctly in the Collection Log (if you already had this item in your Collection Log you may have to reacquire it). Also if you had this item in a current run this change will cause it to incorrectly display as the Heart of the Titan. This is a visual issue only and will not affect new versions of the Shadow Dancer’s Boots
Fixed a bug that caused players to gain Reroll Dice when losing a fight

Quality of Life/Miscellaneous Improvements/Fixes

You can now start a fight by pressing “Space”
Sanctity now fully restores Energy Shield when activated
On Dodge effects now state “On Dodge or Evade”
Hovering over the Mana icon on the Character Sheet now states that you regenerate 2.5% of Maximum Mana per second as a base
The Dark Iron Greatshield and Vanguard bonuses now specify Attack Block Chance instead of just “Block Chance”
Hovering over an enemy’s name or level will display the current modifier bonus of each floor
In the Collection Log, Auras now state their required class (if applicable)

Closing Words

To ensure you are playing on the correct version, ensure the main menu reads “1.0.5”. You may have to update, verify your game files or re-install your game

Cheers,
Gronkins

notes.title: Dungeon Exiles - 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Gronkins here with patch 1.0.3! This is another smaller patch, focusing on fixing some bugs, some general improvements and yet again, adding in a new random event! So let’s get into it!

New Random Event

You’ll now be able to encounter the Treasure Seeker within the dungeon! The Treasure Seeker will sell you some random items, but at a discount! If you wish you can haggle for more items, however, you may upset him and pay a higher price, so be warned! This event can start spawning on floor 1

Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug where Guarded Protection of Elements was applying the wrong bonuses
Fixed a bug where Fortified Determination was applying the wrong bonuses
Fixed a bug that caused certain crowd control effects to not apply on the first application
Fixed a bug where certain status effects (such as Chilled) weren’t displaying their effects
Fixed an issue that caused the Goliath Braces item to not spawn correctly
Fixed an issue that caused the Serpent's Fang item to not spawn correctly
Fixed a bug where the dialogue box was appearing on top of the map
Fixed a bug where custom dialogue formatting wasn’t applying when skipping dialogue
Fixed a display issue with Attack Dodge and Spell Dodge displaying too many decimal places
Fixed an issue where the Questing Knight was giving 4% Health Regeneration per Second instead of 0.4%

General Fixes / Quality of Life

The game now remembers what combat speed you were using in the previous fight
The Character Sheet now displays the maximum value of certain stats, such as resistances, evasion chance, block chance, etc
Changed skill descriptions that stacked up to 999 times to no longer say “stacking infinitely” instead they say “stacking up to 999 times”
Fixed some more typos

Closing Words

This was another quick update to fix some bugs and to add a new random event. Currently, I’m just focusing on improving the core game and trying to get it as stable and polished as I can, so I hope you enjoy!

To ensure you are playing on the correct version, ensure the main menu reads “1.0.3”. You may have to update, verify your game files or re-install your game

Cheers,
Gronkins

notes.title: Dungeon Exiles 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Gronkins here with patch 1.0.1. So, first of all, I’d just like to say thank you to everyone who has been playing and supporting Dungeon Exiles! Dungeon Exiles has reached so many more players than I ever expected so with that in mind, I plan on continuing to support Dungeon Exiles

However the main focus of this specific patch is balance changes, QoL changes, and I’ve also added a new item and a new modifier that can be found on equipment. So let’s get into it!

Quality of Life Features

The dialogue skip system has been reworked. Now you can simply click on a dialogue box to skip the dialogue. Moreover, skipping the dialogue no longer speeds up the dialogue text, instead it fully completes the current dialogue

Tooltips for most buffs, debuffs and skills now state exactly what effects are granted. For example, the “Resilient” modifier on enemies no longer says “Takes less Damage From Critical Strikes” but instead says “30% Reduced Extra Damage Taken From Critical Strikes”

This also applies to debuffs. For example, Vulnerable no longer says “Takes Increased Damage” but now says “Takes 25% Increased Damage”

Game Balance

The maximum Cooldown Recovery Rate has been reduced from 95% to 75%
There is now a cooldown on Crowd Control effects such as Stun, Fear and Freeze. If a character has been Stunned, Feared or Frozen, they are immune to Crowd Control effects for 4 seconds

Endless Mode Balance

Enemies on Floors 11-15 (Endless Mode) have had their damage reduced by roughly 12%

Passive Skills

Rogue

Dark Adrenaline:
Percentage of Attack Damage Leeched as Health: 2.5% -> 2.2%

Mage

Deep Thoughts:
Increased Maximum Mana: 26% -> 24%

Storm Chaser:
Increased Maximum Mana: 18% -> 16%

Synergy Bonuses

Mage

Archmage 1:
Mana Regeneration (per Second): 0.5 -> 0.4

Archmage 8:
Increased Maximum Mana: 45% -> 40%

Warrior

Colossus 8:
Increased Maximum Health: 25% -> 30%

Abilities

Warrior

Guardbreak has been reworked. Guardbreak has been renamed to Crush and no longer reduces the enemy’s chance to block attacks. Instead, Crush has an additional chance to deal Critical Strikes starting at 15% at level 1

Devastate (Base):
Percentage of Physical Attack Damage: 140% -> 150%

Mage

Fireball, Frostbolt and Lightning Bolt:
Mana cost per level: 2 -> 3
Additionally, the damage of Fireball, Frostbolt and Lightning Bolt has been reduced by roughly 4% at all levels

Rogue

Vampiric Strikes (Base):
Percentage of Attack Damage Leeched as Health: 8% -> 7%

Items

Manaforged Heart:
Maximum Mana per Intelligence: 4 -> 2

New Items:

Stormguard:
Treasure Item, Epic quality, Warrior only

+12% chance to Block Attacks
+15% Lightning Resistance
Reflect 1-15 Lightning Damage to Attacker on Block

Stormguard can be unlocked by earning the new Achievement “You Can Take This Back” which involves dealing 10,000 reflected damage in a single run

Item Modifiers

Evasion Item Modifiers have had their values reduced by -1/-1 at all Item Tiers. For example at Item Tier 1:
A 14-16 Evasion roll has been reduced to 13-15

Cooldown Recovery Rate Item Modifiers have had their values reduced by -1%/0% at all Item Tiers. For example at Item Tier 1:
A 3%-4% Cooldown Recovery Rate roll has been reduced to 2%-4%
Moreover, Cooldown Recovery Rate Item Modifiers have been reduced by an additional 0%/-1% at Item Tier 5

New Modifier: Reflect Physical Damage to Attacker on Block. This new modifier can be found on shields

Miscellenous Changes

Added Resolution support for 1280x720 (16:9) and 3440x1440 (21:9)
Adjusted the tooltip text for consumables to refer to the fact that Reroll Dice are not food
Added a hotkey for Map toggling (The Hotkey is “M”)
Added more display information about certain conditions, such as Shielded and Guarded
Added more tooltip information for status effects such as Chilled, Shocked, Vulnerable, and Weak

Bug Fixes/General Fixes

Fixed a display bug for certain stats
Fixed a typo during the Floor 3 loading screen

Closing Words

I just wanted to say another thank you to everyone who has checked out and played Dungeon Exiles! I truly never imagined this many people would be playing and I hope everyone is having fun!

To ensure you are playing on the correct version, ensure the main menu reads “1.0.1”. You may have to update, verify your game files or re-install your game

Cheers,
Gronkins

notes.title: Dungeon Exiles 0.5.4
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Gronkins here with patch 0.5.4 of Dungeon Exiles! So this may be one of the last patches for the demo as the full version is releasing very soon! In case you haven’t heard, the official release date of Dungeon Exiles is the 8th of August and the Steam page has been updated with this information. But with that out of the way, let’s get into the patch notes!

Game Balance

Evasion has been reworked to follow an entropy-based system so over time evading will be more consistent. For example, if attacked ten times with a 30% evasion chance, you will always evade 3 hits

Note: Dodge is still fully random and does not follow this entropy-based system

Passives

Rogue

Blade Dance:
Percentage of Maximum Overguard on Hit: 1.5% -> 1%

Warrior

Against All Odds:
Increased Armour: 28% -> 32%

Barricade:
Chance of Gaining Armour: 25% -> 35%

Battle Vigor:
Increased Maximum Health: 5% -> 6%

Born Fighter:
Block Chance: 5% -> 6%
Increased Mana Regeneration: 25% -> 0%
Increased Bleed Damage: 0% -> 25%

Brutal Strikes:
Chance to Bleed: 10% -> 12%

Carnage Fighter:
Increased Mana Regeneration: 12% -> 0%
Increased Attack Speed: 0% -> 10%

Commanding Presence:
Increased Mana Regeneration: 15% -> 25%

Endless Endurance:
Percent of Health Regenerated per Second: 0.5% -> 0.6%

Fervour:
Increased Attack Speed: 15% -> 20%

Heavy Strikes:
Increased Attack Damage: 12% -> 14%
Critical Strike Chance: 4% -> 6%

Painbringer:
Increased Attack Damage: 18% -> 20%

Replenishing Defence:
Now restores 0.4% of Maximum Mana per second while Guarded

Retaliation:
Increased Attack Damage: 8% -> 10%

Revenge:
Activation Chance: 10% -> 20%

Savage Recovery:
Percentage of Health Restored on Melee Critical: 1% -> 2%

Unbreakable:
Armour: 14 -> 18
Increased Armour: 14% -> 16%

Unflinching:
No longer activates on taking a Critical Strike
Now has a 20% chance to activate when taking a hit
Duration (Seconds): 10 -> 8

Traits

Warrior

Vanguard 2:
Block Chance: 8% -> 10%

Juggernaut 2:
Armour: 14 -> 16
No longer provides 18% increased Armour
It instead provides: Reflect 3 Physical Damage to Attackers when Hit

Berserker 2:
Increased Attack Speed: 10% -> 12%

Colossus 4:
Increased Health Regeneration: 8% -> 10%

Gladiator 2:
Increased Attack Speed: 8% -> 10%
Chance to Bleed: 15% -> 20%

Gladiator 4:
Duration (Seconds): 7 -> 6
Block Chance: 10% -> 12%
Increased Attack Speed: 12% -> 18%

Enemy Balance

Enemies

The Grave Warden:
Can no longer inflict Fear with Attacks
Soul Slash Coodown (Seconds): 5 -> 6

Modifiers

Bonebreaker (the modifier that provided enemies with a chance to Stun) can no longer randomly spawn

Events

Ancient Forge:
No longer costs a percentage of your Maximum Resolve, it has been converted into a flat amount

Abandoned Campsite:
Resting at the campsite now restores slightly more Resolve

The Mysterious Alchemist:
Now has a chance to give a new and exclusive potion called the Potion of Stoneskin which grants:
Gain 5% of Maximum Overguard per second for 8 seconds

Items

All Mage Weapons (excluding Treasure Items) have had their Maximum Elemental Damage to Spells reduced by 1 at all Item Tiers.

Rusty Dagger:
No longer provides increased Attack Speed
Instead, it provides extra Physical Damage to Attacks, starting at 1 - 1 at Item Tier 1

Serpent’s Fang:
Now requires Nightmare 2 to unlock, which means it will no longer be available in the demo version of Dungeon Exiles. To compensate, a new item will be replacing it

New Item:
Sturdy Boots
Requires: Rogue
Provides Health and Evasion

Consumable Items

Some of the consumable items have been adjusted so they feel a bit more unique

Potion of Might:
Increased Damage: 65% -> 50%
Critical Strike Chance: 0% -> 25%

Potion of Haste:
Increased Attack Speed: 60% -> 50%
Increased Cooldown Recovery Rate: 0% -> 20%

Potion of Regeneration:
Percentage of Health Regenerated per second: 5% -> 3%
Duration (Seconds): 6 -> 10

Potion of Mana Regeneration:
Duration (Seconds): 6 -> 8

Miscelleneous Changes

Added new text to display the current floor
The attack animations for the Rogue and Mage have been improved
Added a new option under Settings to auto-skip non-combat dialogue
Added a Dodge sound effect
The credits panel now correctly closes when pressing Escape
Updated some ability tooltips so they no longer say “Activates upon reaching full Mana”

Bug Fixes

The settings panel now correctly closes when pressing Escape
Fixed a bug that caused the volume settings to be louder than intended when creating a new save file
Fixed a bug that caused enemies to spawn with the Flametouched modifier more often than intended

Closing Words

So that’s everything for patch 0.5.4! If you are enjoying Dungeon Exiles remember to wishlist it and check out the full version when it releases on the 8th of August!

To ensure you are playing on the correct version, ensure the main menu reads “0.5.4”. You may have to update, verify your game files or re-install your game

I hope you enjoy the new update!

Cheers,
Gronkins

notes.title: Dungeon Exiles 0.5.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Gronkins here with patch 0.5.3 of Dungeon Exiles! The main focus of this update is game balance (in terms of items, passives, synergies and abilities) and some small miscellaneous fixes as I prepare for the full release of Dungeon Exiles which hopefully can be expected early next month. But with all that said, let’s get into it!

Game Balance

Global Cooldown (Seconds): 1 -> 0.5

Trait Bonuses

Warrior

Berserker 2:
No longer requires being on low health
Increased Attack Speed: 12% -> 10%

Berserker 4:
No longer grants extra Critical Strike Multiplier while on low health
Instead, it grants 0.5% increased Attack Speed on hit for 6 seconds, stacking up to 50 times

Berserker 6:
No longer restores 2.5% of Maximum Mana on Attack Critical Strike
Instead, it grants 0.5% increased Attack Speed and 0.1% Critical Strike Chance on Attack Critical Strike, stacking infinitely

Juggernaut 4:
No longer grants Elemental Resistance or Nature Resistance
Instead, it Reflects Physical Damage equal to 5% of your Armour to your Attacker

Champion 6:
No longer grants Start with 8% Overguard
It instead grants gain 3% increased Attack Speed for 5 seconds, stacking up to 10 times after casting a Spell or Ability

Juggernaut 2:
Armour: 12 -> 14

Colossus 4:
Percentage Health Regeneration: 0.5% -> 0.6%

Colossus 6:
Percent of Maximum Health gained as Extra Physical Attack Damage: 1% -> 1.2%

Gladiator 4:
No longer grants Block Chance and Bleed Damage
Instead, grants gain 10% Block Chance and 12% Attack Speed for 7 seconds after Inflicting a Bleed

Gladiator 6:
No longer restores 2.5% of Maximum Mana on Bleed
Instead it grants Inflict Bleed whenever you block

Rogue

Alchemist 2:
Percent Health Regenerated per Second: 0.4% -> 0%
Maximum Mana: 0 -> 12

Assassin 2:
Critical Strike Chance: 2.5% -> 4%

Assassin 4:
No longer grants 25% armour penetration
Instead, it grants 4% Critical Strike Chance and 4% increased Attack Speed after dealing a Critical Strike for 5 seconds, stacking up to 3 times

Duelist 2:
Parry Chance: 8% -> 10%

Duelist 4:
No longer grants 35% Chance to Gain 3 Overguard on Hit
Instead, it grants Reflect Physical Damage equal to 50% of your Physical Attack Damage to your Attacker and gain 2.5% of Maximum Overguard on Parry

Bloodreaper 4:
No longer restores 0.5% of Maximum Health on Bleed
Instead, it grants 12% increased Attack Speed and restores 2 Health on Hit for 5 seconds after inflicting a Bleed

Bloodreaper 6:
Percentage of Attack Damage leech: 1.2% -> 2%
Increased Maximum Health: 5% -> 0%
Increased Chance to Bleed: 0% -> 10%

Shadowstalker 4:
Percentage of Physical Attack Damage as Extra Shadow Damage: 10% -> 12%

Shadowstalker 6:
Percentage of Attack Damage Leeched as Energy Shield: 3% -> 2.5%

Mage

Warden 2:
Percentage of Energy Shield Regenerated per second: 0.5% -> 0%
Increased Maximum Energy Shield: 0% -> 12%

Pyromancer 2:
Increased Fire Damage: 10% -> 12%
Chance to Ignite: 10% -> 12%

Pyromancer 4:
Critical Strike Chance: 2.5% -> 4%
Critical Strike Multiplier: 10% -> 12%

Archmage 6:
Percentage of Mana as Extra Energy Shield: 12% -> 18%

Electromancer 6:
Effect Duration (Seconds): 10 -> 8
Increased Lightning Damage: 25% -> 30%

Warden 4:
Increased Maximum Energy Shield: 14% -> 0%

Warden 6:
Percentage of Maximum Energy Shield Regenerated Per Second: 1% -> 1.2%
Increased Maximum Energy Shield: 0% -> 12%

Passive Skills

Level requirements for passives have been standardised into the following distribution for each archetype:

Requires Level 1: 2
Requires Level 3: 1
Requires Level 4: 1
Requires Level 5: 2
Requires Level 6: 1
Requires Level 8: 1

Warrior

Battle Vigor:
Percent Health Regenerated Per Second: 0.4% -> 0.5%

Brutal Block:
Has been renamed to Fuel the Fight
Fuel the Fight no longer has 50% chance to inflict Bleed on Block
Instead, it restores 2.5% of Maximum Mana when inflicting a Bleed

Spiked Aegis:
No longer Reflects 6 Physical Damage to your Attacker on Block
Instead, it Reflects Physical Damage equal to 35% of your Physical Attack Damage to your Attacker on Block

Walking Fortress:
Increased Physical Damage: 10% -> 12%

Furious Strikes:
Increased Attack Speed: 4% -> 5%

Heavy Strikes:
Critical Strike Chance: 3.5% -> 4%

Savagery:
Rarity: Common -> Uncommon
No longer grants 3.5% Critical Strike Chance
No longer grants 12% Critical Strike Multiplier
It instead grants restore 2.5% of Maximum Mana on Attack Critical

Endless Rage:
Has been renamed to Savage Recovery
No longer grants Increased Attack Speed on Hit
It instead grants restore 1% of Maximum Health on Attack Critical

Berserker:
Has been renamed to Barbarism
No longer grants Increased Attack Damage while on low Health
It instead grants 25% chance on Hit to gain 6% Critical Strike Chance and 18% increased Attack Damage for 7 seconds

Executioner:
Increased Attack Damage: 24% -> 0%
Critical Strike Chance: 0% -> 6%
Critical Strike Multiplier: 0% -> 18%

Frenzy:
No longer grants Attack Speed while on low Health

notes.title: Dungeon Exiles 0.5.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Gronkins here with patch 0.5.1 of Dungeon Exiles! So, this is the first patch winding down from the Steam Next Fest. Firstly, let me just say thank you to everyone who played Dungeon Exiles during the Next Fest and gave me valuable feedback! So, I have some important news in these patch notes as well so be sure to read it!

Important News

So for the full version of Dungeon Exiles, I’m changing the maximum number of floors from 10 to 5. The reasoning is that each floor can take 10-20 minutes, meaning that 10 floors would be too long for a single run. This doesn’t affect the demo (as the demo only has 3 floors) but this is something to keep in mind for the release of Dungeon Exiles. However, this news does mean that the full release of Dungeon Exiles will come sooner, but I’ll give you more information on that closer to the date. With all that out of the way, here is the rest of the patch notes!

Abilities

In the original version of Dungeon Exiles, I had planned 10 floors of content with many of the later floors being themed about elemental damage (such as Cold, Fire and Lightning). However, these plans have changed, and elemental damage is quite uncommon on floors 1-5, meaning Protection of Elements was quite weak. So I’m changing Protection of Elements to provide resistance against both Nature and Shadow damage

Protection of Elements:
Elemental Resistance: 28% ->  12%
Nature Resistance: 0% -> 12%
Shadow Resistance: 0% -> 12%
Elemental Resistance per level: 3% -> 2%
Nature Resistance per level: 0% -> 2%
Shadow Resistance per level: 0% -> 2%

Passive skills

Warrior
Mage Guard no longer grants 12% increased Attack Damage, it instead grants Restore 2% of Maximum Mana on Block
Lord of Steel no longer grants 1% increased Attack Damage per Energy Shield, it now grants 20% increased Attack Damage while Shielded. Lord of Steel is no longer Rare rarity, it is now Uncommon rarity

Traits

Alchemist 6:
Mana restored on Poison: 5% -> 2.5%

Enrage Mechanics

The enrage mechanic has been refined. There is now a timer that shows up for every fight so you can see how long you have. The enrage timer varies from regular enemies, to elites, to bosses, and changes per floor. The enrage mechanic isn’t new, however, the old timer was far too forgiving (50 seconds for a regular enemy), the intent is that you need to have a more balanced build and can’t purely focus on defence and defeat your enemies through a battle of attrition

Item Implicit Modifiers

The implicit modifiers of items now scale with Item Tier, and unlike the random modifiers, implicit modifiers are guaranteed based on the Item Tier. So for example, the armour rolls of a Tier 3 Avential Helmet will always be higher than the rolls of a Tier 1 Avential Helmet (Of course, a poorly rolled Tier 3 Helmet may be similar to equal to a Tier 3 Helmet). To compensate for these changes a few items have had their base implicit stats adjusted:

Rusty Dagger:
Increased Attack Speed: 5%-10% -> 4%-10%

Leather Belt:
Maximum Health: 5-8 -> 4-8

Mana Crystal:
Maxmimum Mana: 5-10 -> 6-8

Serpent’s Eye Charm:
Increased Critical Strike Chance: 20%-35% -> 20%-30%

Daring Bucker:
Gold Cost: 60 -> 65
Block Chance: 3%-6% -> 3%-5%

Item Modifiers

Health on Dodge (New):
Tier 1: 3-4
Tier 2: 4-5
Tier 3: 5-6

Health on Dodge can roll on Evasion-based equipment

Energy Shield on Cast:
Tier 2: 1-3 -> 2-3
Tier 3: 2-3 -> 2-4

Items

Aspect of Nature:
Nature Resistance required per 0.1% Health Regeneration: 5% -> 10%

Miscellaneous Changes

Adjusted the cursor so it is brighter
Re-added Health bar chip-away effect
The Battle Tactics tutorial now also shows up once, in future fights, it has been replaced by a simple “Ready” button
You can now speed up non-combat dialogue by pressing the new button that appears within the dialogue box

Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug where the shop menu wasn’t closing properly
Fixed a bug where certain Health Regeneration amounts were considered ints for the purpose of upgrading (for example, 1 Health Regeneration on an item when upgraded wouldn’t provide 1.3 after the upgrade)
Fixed a bug that caused weapon-based abilities to gain twice as much scaling from the generic increased damage stat

Closing Words

So that is everything for patch 0.5.1! Again I just want to say thank you to everyone who tried out Dungeon Exiles during the Next Fest and I hope you all enjoyed it!

To play the newest update, ensure the main menu reads “0.5.1”. You may have to update, validate game files or re-install your game to play the newest update.

Cheers, 
Gronkins

notes.title: Dungeon Exiles 0.5.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Gronkins here with patch 0.5.0 of Dungeon Exiles! This has been a pretty major update in preparation for the Steam Next Fest! This update mainly features revamps of old systems and graphical improvements so let’s get right into it!

Graphical Updates

Lighting Effects

A basic lighting system has been implemented in Dungeon Exiles so the world feels a lot darker and more immersive.

Ability Animations

Most abilities have had new animations applied, such as spell and buff effects, or slashing animations for attack-based abilities. In the future I want each ability to have a unique animation, but currently some abilities use the same animation and a few abilities still lack animations entirely, but it’s something I’ll fix in the future.

Random Events

Random events have been reworked to be more engaging and provide a more immersive experience. Random events now feature NPCs and/or interactable objects.

Removed Random Events:
Hidden Stash
Divine Fountain

New/Re-added Random Events:
Mysterious Potion Seller
Ancient Forge

Game Balance

Passive Skills

Rogue
New: Toxic Application (Alchemist): Restore 1% of Maximum Health on Poison
New: Lifeline (Bloodreaper): Restore 3 Health on Hit while below 50% Health

Passive Skill Balance

Rogue
Leeching Strikes: 1% Percent Health Restored on Hit -> 1.5% Percent Health Restored on Hit
Afterimage: 5 Health on Dodge -> 6 Health on Dodge
Aspect of the Serpent: No longer grants 12% Nature Resistance, it instead grants 12% increased Maximum Mana
Blade Dance: 30% chance to Gain 2 Overguard on Hit -> 35% chance to Gain 2 Overguard on Hit
Crimson Thirst: 1.8% Attack Damage Leeched as Life -> 2% Attack Damage Leeched As Life
Cruel Momentum: 5-second duration -> 6-second duration
Envenom: 8% increased Mana Regeneration -> 14% increased Mana Regeneration
Dark Adrenaline: No longer grants 1.2% Health Regenerated per second for 3 seconds after Critical Strike. It instead grants 3.5% Attack Damage Leeched as Health for 5 seconds after Attack Critical Strike

Trait Balance

Rogue
Bloodreaper 1: No longer grants 12 Maximum Health, it instead grants 1 Health gained on Hit
Assassin 3: No longer grants 5% Armour Shred on Critical Strike, it instead grants Restore 1% of Maximum Health on Attack Critical Strike

Warrior
Berserker 3: No longer grants 12% increased Armour while below 50% Health. It instead grants Restore 2% of Maximum Mana on Attack Critical Strike.

Ability Balance

Rogue:
Cheap Shot: Base damage increased from 40% to 50%.
Sinister Strike: Base damage increased from 90% to 100%.

Mage:
Time Warp: Base cooldown reduced by 4 seconds.

Item Modifiers

Health Regeneration (Per second):
Tier 1: 0.2-0.5 -> 0.3-0.6
Tier 2: 0.3-0.6 -> 0.4-0.8
Tier 3: 0.4-0.8 -> 0.5-1

Maximum Mana:
Tier 1: 6-10 -> 8-10

Increased Mana Regeneration
Tier 1: 10%-18% -> 14%-18%
Tier 2: 12%-20% -> 16%-22%
Tier 3: 14%-22% -> 18%-26%

Legendaries

I want all legendaries to feel extremely powerful and build defining, so I’m giving a few some extra help.

Forgemaster’s Hammer: 20% of Physical Damage as Extra Fire Damage -> 25% of Physical as Extra Fire Damage
Lifedrinker: 15% increased Attack Speed -> 20% increased Attack Speed
Lifedrinker: Critical Strike Chance Needed for 1% Lifesteal: 10% -> 7.5%
Manaforged Heart: 20% of Mana as Extra Health -> 25% of Mana as Extra Health
Manaforged Heart: 20% increased Mana Regeneration -> 30% increased Mana Regeneration

Enemy Balance

Blight Caller’s Spreading Plague Damage: 21-26 -> 22-25

Enemy Modifiers Balancing

There was a bug that caused percent increases and reductions to maximum Health to not correctly apply so I’m nerfing a few enemy modifiers to compensate.

Regenerator: 0.075% Health per Second -> 0.05% Health per Second
Hearty: 30% increased Maximum Health -> 25% increased Maximum Health
Shielded: 30% Health as ES -> 20% Health as ES

Items

Radiant Torch can no longer be found as random loot from enemies.
Potion of Mana Regeneration no longer grants 80% increased Mana Regeneration, it instead grants Regenerate 5% of Maximum Mana per Second

Resolve Changes

The Resolve system has been simplified. Resolve no longer grants any buffs or debuffs, and you no longer lose Resolve from exploration, but you still lose Resolve from losing fights (and losing to a boss will still end your run). The intent is that Resolve will be mainly used as a resource for engaging with Random Events and other similar systems.

Miscellaneous Changes

The Rogue has new art.
You can now see your floor completion for each class on the class selection screen.

Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug that caused increases and reductions to Maximum Health to not correctly apply. In short, all characters (players and enemies) were gaining less health from passives than they should have. This bug (I believe) was introduced in patch 0.4.7 and I’ll be monitoring how this affects game balance very closely.

Closing Words

So that is everything for patch 0.5.0! The main focus of this update was to add as much polish and juice to the game as I could before the Steam Next Fest. There is still a lot more than I want to do, but this is as much as I could do given the timeframe.

To play the newest update, ensure the main menu reads “0.5.0”. You may have to update, validate game files or re-install your game to play the newest update.

Cheers, 
Gronkins

notes.title: Dungeon Exiles 0.4.8
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Gronkins here with patch 0.4.8 of Dungeon Exiles! I’m very excited as this update fixes a lot of issues with the game, but also introduces the Mage class so let’s get into it!

New Playable Class: The Mage

The Mage is an enigmatic caster, specialising in dealing elemental damage with spells and protecting themselves with magical Energy Shield. The Mage has all new abilities, traits, passive skills and items. To unlock the Mage you need to defeat the boss of the third floor. If you have beaten the boss of the third floor already (as of patch 0.4.7) you will already have the Mage unlocked.

Critical Strike Rework

Crit builds have been a consistent problem in Dungeon Exiles, even back in the old itch.io days. Due to the way Critical Strike Chance worked in Dungeon Exiles, it was very easy to reach high amounts of Critical Strike Chance to deal overwhelming amounts of damage. This wasn’t too much of an issue with the Warrior, however with the Rogue back in the game I noticed that crit-centric builds were vastly overperforming compared to other build archetypes for the amount of investment required. Players who were able to approach 100% Critical Strike Chance were able to kill bosses in less than 10 seconds which is not intended, so I’ve decided to rework crit which will be a sizable nerf to all current crit-builds.

With the old system, it was too easy to reach high crit chance amounts. Playing as the Rogue (7.5% Crit chance), you could pick up a Level 1 Precision (12% Crit Chance), a Level 1 Cruel Intent (25% Crit Chance) and the Lifedrinker legendary sword (15% Crit Chance) for a total of 59.5% Crit Chance without having a single passive or non-treasure item.

Crit has a place in Dungeon Exiles, but it’s too easy to reach high numbers currently, so I’m introducing a new stat called Increased Critical Strike Chance which is a percentage stat that increases your Critical Strike Chance based on your base Critical Strike Chance. For example, the Warrior starts with 5% Critical Strike Chance, and if they gained 50% Increased Critical Strike Chance that would increase the base by 50%, resulting in a total of 7.5% Critical Strike Chance. This new stat has replaced all current instances of the old Critical Strike Chance stat and the values have been rebalanced accordingly. 

I’m aware that this is a large nerf to crit builds so I will be monitoring their strength closely in the following updates and will provide buffs as necessary. I believe this change is necessary as full-crit builds were able to deal significantly more damage than any other archetype with relatively low investment.

Lastly, as part of this change, the Rogue’s starting Critical Strike Chance has been reduced from 7.5% to 6%.

Class Balance

Synergy Adjustments

Trait bonuses have been changed to occur at every 2 passives. For example, bonuses for Champion are no longer unlocked at 2, 3, 4 and 6, but instead, they are unlocked at 2, 4, 6, and 8. This change was made to make upgrades more consistent, but also in preparation for the Early Access release of Dungeon Exiles as the full game will be significantly longer than the demo. I am aware that this is a nerf to synergy bonuses across the board, so I will be monitoring player power in the following updates and will provide buffs if necessary. It is worth noting that this change means some 8 synergy bonuses are not currently achievable so they have been removed temporarily until more passive skills are added.

Synergy Balance

Assassin 2 Armour Penetration: 30% -> 25%
Assassin 4 no longer grants 0.5% of Maximum Health on Critical Strike, instead, it reduces the target’s armour by 5% for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

Bloodreaper 1 Bleed Chance: 12% -> 15%
Bloodreaper 2 no longer grants 1 Health gained on Hit

Colossus 1 now also grants 0.3 Health Regenerated per Second.

Passive Skills

Warrior has a new passive skill called Brutal Block for Gladiator which inflicts a bleed whenever you block an attack.

Abilities

There is now a global cooldown when an ability is activated. If an ability is currently not on cooldown and an ability is cast, it will go on a 1-second global cooldown. This is to prevent multiple spells or abilities from activating at the same time.

Resolve Changes

Losing a fight no longer grants any XP or Gold.

Enemy Balance

Blight Caller’s Spreading Plague Damage: 20-26 -> 21-26

Items

Lifedrinker
Increased Attack Speed: 20% -> 15%
Critical Strike Chance per 1% Attack Leech: 15% -> 12%

Arcanist’s Flamesword
Implicit Fire Damage: 1-2 to 2-4 -> 1-2 to 2-3
Serpent's Fang
Implicit Nature Damage: 1-2 to 3-4 -> 1-2 to 3-3
Radiant Torch
Resolve Gained: 30 -> 25

Keen Spirit Blade and Temporal Hourglass can no longer be found in shops or as rewards from random events.

Class Specific Items

Swift Rapier and General’s Battle Axe are now Warrior and Rogue-specific items
Goliath’s Bracers and Avential Helmet are now Warrior-specific items
Serpent's Fang and Ranger’s Gambeson are now Rogue-specific items

Mage can now find the following class-specific items

Volcanic Fireorb which grants added fire spell damage
Staff of Storms which grants added lightning spell damage
Frost Orb which grants added cold spell damage
Sage’s Robe which grants Maximum Energy Shield

Item Modifiers

Health gain on Hit can no longer roll on items lower than tier 3.
Flat attack stats (such as Added Cold Damage to Attacks or Added Fire Damage to Attacks) have been slightly reduced to match the numbers of Physical attack stats.
The Shield Signet is now considered an Energy Shield item and can roll Energy Shield modifiers.

Enemy Modifiers

Two new modifiers can spawn on enemies starting on Floor 3:

Bonebreaker: Attacks have a chance to Stun. Stun works exactly how you would expect, a character who is stunned cannot attack or use spells or abilities.
Spiked Carapace: Reflects damage when hit by an attack.

Miscellaneous Changes

Visual stats on the character select screen can now be hovered over for more information.
Certain interfaces such as the Character Sheet, Skillbook, Spellbook, and Equipment Screen now have a close button.
Protection of Elements has new art.

Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug where Level 4 Protection of Elements was incorrectly giving the bonuses of Level 3 Protection of Elements.
Fixed a bug where Level 3 Precision had no upgrades.
Fixed a bug where Champion 2 was granting 0% chance to gain Overguard.
Fixed a bug with the tooltip for Agility.
Fixed a bug that allowed players to rest and forge at the same campfire.

Closing Words

So that is everything for patch 0.4.8! This patch has a lot of changes so feel free to try it out and check out the new Mage class! So this is likely to be the last ‘major’ patch until the June Steam Next Fest (only two weeks from now!). Until then, my focus is going to be on refining the game, fixing bugs, balancing and general polishing.

To play the newest update, ensure the main menu reads “0.4.8”. You may have to update, validate game files or re-install your game to play the newest update.

Cheers, 
Gronkins

notes.title: Dungeon Exiles 0.4.7
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Gronkins here with patch 0.4.7! The main focus of this update is the returning Rogue class and Legendary items! So, let’s just get right into it:

Returning class: The Rogue

In patch 0.4.7 the Rogue returns… again… With all new traits, synergies and abilities. The Rogue is squishier than the Warrior, but in turn boasts high damage with critical strikes and poisons and can deftly evade attacks. To unlock the Rogue you’ll need to defeat the boss of the second floor.

Game balance

As more classes get introduced into Dungeon Exiles, I need to account for differing power levels (especially at the start of the game). So, across the board, all non-boss enemies have had their damage reduced by roughly 5%-10%. The idea is that the earlier floors will be easier as you get your build off the ground, but later floors are intended to be quite difficult and will require a powerful build.

Game Mechanics

Shield

Shield has been slightly reworked in patch 0.4.7 and has been renamed to Energy Shield. Energy Shield is now represented as a light blue barrier that covers your health bar. When displaying your current Energy Shield it is added to your current health total. So for example, if you have 100 Maximum Health and you full health plus 50 Energy Shield it will be displayed as:
150/100

Lastly, you’ll no longer be able to exceed your Maximum Energy Shield through restoration effects. I believe this will make Energy Shield a more intuitive mechanic.

Overguard

You may be thinking that a change like that will be a large nerf to Warrior as they typically don’t have much Maximum Energy Shield and thus effects like Steelskin which grants shield will be significantly weaker. To address this issue a new mechanic called Overguard has been introduced which works similarly to how the old Shield system worked.

Overguard will protect both your Health and Energy Shield from damage until it is depleted. Also, it’s worth noting that Overguard has a maximum equal to your Maximum Health + Energy Shield. For example, if you had 100 Health and 100 Energy Shield, then you would be able to gain up to a maximum of 200 Overguard.

Certain effects that used to grant Shield (such as Steelskin) now grant Overguard.

Chaos Cards

The Lone Survivor has been renamed to the Survivor. The Survivor no longer grants -75 to Maximum Shield, and it no longer grants 15 Shield Regenerated per 5 seconds. The Survivor now grants 50% reduced Maximum Energy Shield, additionally, it now grants 1.5% of Maximum Health Regenerated per Second.

Items

Item tiers

To really lean into the fantasy of character-building and progression, item tiers have been introduced. Items that are found in shops have an item tier that increases as you descend floors, item tiers allow items to roll higher and higher stats. The idea is that as you progress further in the dungeon you’ll find better items which you allow your character to scale even harder.

Treasure Items

Epics

Crown of Celestial Insight no longer grants 15% Reduced Extra Damage taken from Critical Strikes. It now grants +12 to Maximum Energy Shield.

Aetheric Essence Stone no longer grants 10% Increased Cooldown Recovery Rate. It now grants +18 to Maximum Mana.

New: Evening Shroud. Gives +4 to Dexterity, +20 to Evasion and +12 to Maximum Health.

Legendaries

In patch 0.4.7 you’ll be able to find legendaries in treasure chests. Currently, they are a guaranteed spawn on floor 3. Legendaries are very powerful items that provide players with new avenues to scale their character.

Stats

Evasion (New)

It’s worth noting that Evading and Dodging a hit are identical mechanics-wise. Evading hit will still cause all On-Dodge effects to trigger and just for full clarity, if a hit is Dodged or Evaded it means that no damage is taken but also it will not trigger On-Hit effects for the enemy (such as lifesteal) but it will also not trigger When-Hit effects for the player (such as thorns).

Evasion and Dodge do not stack additively. Instead, if you fail to Evade an attack you’ll perform an additional Dodge roll to see if the attack is Dodged and visa-versa. Essentially if you have 50% chance to Evade and 50% chance to Dodge this does not equal 100% chance to avoid damage, instead with 50% Evasion and 50% Dodge your chance to avoid damage is roughly 75%.

Traits

Sentinel 4 no longer grants 8% of Maximum Health as Extra Shield. It instead grants 8% more Armour.

Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug that allowed level 4 abilities to show up when upgrading even if the base ability is at max level.

Misc

Fixed the names of certain upgraded abilities so they reflect their upgraded nature.

Closing Words

So that is everything for patch 0.4.7! Give the Rogue a try and let me know what you think!

To play the newest update, ensure the main menu reads “0.4.7”. You may have to update, validate game files or re-install your game to play the newest update.

Cheers, 
Gronkins

notes.title: Dungeon Exiles 0.4.6
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Gronkins here with patch 0.4.6 of Dungeon Exiles. The main focus of this update was to introduce an ability upgrade system so let’s get into it!

Ability Upgrade System

Every second level you’ll now be offered the option to either select a new ability or upgrade an old one. Abilities can be upgraded to a maximum level of 5.
Upgrading an ability increases its strength, but also its Mana cost. The Mana Reservation of Auras does not increase with level, so to compensate level 1 Auras have been nerfed slightly.
When getting an ability to maximum level you’ll be presented with up to three choices on how to modify the ability. The intent is that all abilities will have a total of three choices, but currently, some abilities only have two upgrade paths.

It’s worth noting that in the demo of Dungeon Exiles, it’s unlikely that you’ll be able to get many abilities to maximum level in a single run as the full version of Dungeon Exiles will be significantly longer and I don’t want to balance abilities around the shorter duration of the demo

Balance Changes

Enemies

Necromancer’s Shadowbolt Fear chance: 50% -> 40%
Floor 3 non-boss enemies have had their damage reduced by roughly 5%

Traits

Sentinel 4 no longer grants 8% of Maximum Health as Extra Maximum Shield, it instead grants 1% increased Attack Damage per 8 Armour
Sentinel 8 has been reduced to Sentinel 6. Additionally, the new Sentinel 6 now grants 8% of Maximum Health as Extra Maximum Shield

Champion 3 no longer grants 1% increased Cooldown Recovery per stack. Champion 3’s Mana Regeneration per stack has been increased from 2.5% to 3%.

Passives

Inspired Strikes Increased Ability Damage: 25% -> 20%

Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug that allowed players to cast spells and abilities while Frozen or Feared.

Closing Words

So this is everything for patch 0.4.6! The ability upgrade system likely won’t have the most impact on the demo of Dungeon Exiles, but this update is more so for laying down the groundwork for the full release of the game, as well as the Early Access version which is steadily approaching

To play the newest update, ensure the main menu reads “0.4.6”. You may have to update, validate game files or re-install your game to play the newest update.

Cheers, 
Gronkins

Closing Words
